answer.rationale: Expiry in 14 days with no auto-renew plus 94% utilization and no buffer makes switch or dual-source onboarding an unacceptable delivery-risk increase; deferral is also unsafe because this contract is critical. Incumbent renewal has been operationally stable (c1). Prior renewal benchmarking recovered price and terms (c4) and multi-year volume commitments cut unit cost without narrowing scope (c6), so negotiating those levers is the one action that can pursue the 18% spend cut while holding integration and allocation risk flat. Verifying c4 before committing because the cost-cut path depends on whether that renegotiation result still generalizes.
